f.pu: The conservation and sustainable management of uninhabited Chumbe Island off Zanzibar
f.re: The Chumbe Reef Sanctuary (CRS) area is a no-take zone (NTZ), and no fishing, extractive or damaging practices are permitted. The Closed Forest Reserve (CFR) are is fully protected, with no extractive practices permitted.
